items.title: Ukraine launches more than 1,000 drones at Russia, setting St Petersburg oil sites ablaze
items.summary: ABC News (AP) and Al Jazeera report that Russia said it downed 1,015 Ukrainian drones over 15 regions on 18 October, while fires broke out at the St Petersburg oil terminal and the Ruchi oil depot. Officials said about 20,000 people lost power and one person was killed. CNN reports President Trump criticised Zelenskyy over the attack, which came after Trump said both sides had agreed to stop hitting energy infrastructure. Casualty and damage figures come from Russian officials and are provisional.
items.why: Strikes on energy sites move oil prices and shipping costs, and the Sensex fell on Monday with Brent above $100, which feeds into corporate budgets and hiring.

items.title: Kenya confirms an eighth Ebola case, all linked to the first patient
items.summary: A 19 October report says Kenya's health officials confirmed an eighth Ebola case and that every infection traces back to the first patient, who died. Earlier AP coverage said the count had reached seven, including health workers who treated that patient, and the ministry judged public risk to be low. The outbreak is linked to the larger epidemic in Congo. The count is still changing, so treat it as provisional.
items.why: Duty of care, contact tracing and clear communication during an outbreak are live HR and brand-crisis lessons.
items.src: My Central Oregon (wire report), ABC News (AP)

items.title: Deloitte raises India's FY27 growth forecast to 7.1-7.3%
items.summary: Business Standard and HDFC Sky report that Deloitte India lifted its FY27 GDP forecast to 7.1 to 7.3 per cent from 6.5 to 6.8 per cent, citing a revival in private investment, and expects 6.6 to 7.0 per cent in FY28. It flags geopolitical tensions, energy-price swings and trade disruptions as risks. The RBI and OECD have projected 7.1 per cent, and the IMF, ADB, S&P and Moody's about 7 per cent.
items.why: Stronger private investment usually means more corporate hiring and bigger marketing budgets, which helps the placement season.

items.title: Seven arrested after the Kolkata Durga Puja crowd crush that killed 19
items.summary: NationPath reports that seven people were arrested after the 17 October crush at the Chorbagan Sarbojanin pandal, where 19 died and 25 were hurt. Investigators are looking at crowd management, blocked exits and public announcements, and the state has ordered a special investigation and promised compensation. This comes from a single outlet and has not been confirmed by a wire service, so treat it as provisional.
items.why: Event safety and organiser accountability matter for anyone running campaigns, activations or campus events.

items.title: Sensex falls 876 points to snap a two-day winning streak
items.summary: HDFC Sky and Upstox report that on 19 October the Sensex closed near 73,853 and the Nifty near 22,889, down about 1.1%, dragged by private banks and IT. Axis Bank fell about 4% after its quarterly profit narrowly missed expectations, and Infosys also fell about 3%. The Nifty Private Bank index lost around 1.9% while PSU banks rose.
items.why: Falling banking and IT stocks hit the sectors that hire the most MBAs, so watch how recruiters talk about budgets.

items.title: Axis Bank closed about 4% lower after its September-quarter results
items.summary: Upstox's gainers and losers list for 19 October shows Axis Bank down about 4%, with Infosys and TMPV also down around 3%, while JSW Steel rose about 2%.
items.why: Bank results are an early signal of credit growth and corporate demand.

items.title: Anthropic commits 5% of its shares to a new public benefit fund
items.summary: TechCrunch, ABC News and Al Jazeera report that Anthropic announced on 18 October it will commit 5% of its shares to a public benefit fund, subject to stockholder approval. The fund would be a wholly owned LLC that could make large donations to nonprofits or direct distributions, including efforts on AI's effect on jobs, and would not be used for lobbying. Anthropic says more detail on governance will follow in the coming months, and reports link the move to a possible IPO as soon as November.
items.why: How AI companies share value and address job disruption shapes employer branding, workforce planning and the debate about AI and hiring.

items.title: The fund can grow by 2% of shares for every 50% rise in Anthropic's value
items.summary: Forbes and other outlets say the board has the option to add 2% more shares for each 50% increase in the company's value, and that combined pledges could dedicate roughly 20% of shares to public purposes.
items.why: Pledges tied to company value are a template for corporate giving that marketers and HR teams will be asked to explain.
